question: (a) As the inhibitory set's output is reduced, do the rhythm-driving DNs lose their rhythm by ignition? (b) As it is increased, does DNg100_L gain a rhythm without igniting?
intervention_disclosure: Synaptic weights of a declared inhibitory set are scaled as a model-level causal probe; every level is fixed in advance and every outcome reported. Not a live-engine change, a fidelity correction, or a biological claim about DNg100's inhibition.
not_claimed: that DNg100's inhibition is biologically too weak
anything about the live LIF engine
a change to motor admission, weights or mappings in the live engine

sources.cache: maleCNS cache (load_cache verifies the canonical source fingerprints)
sources.hash_rule: text files: sha256 after CRLF -> LF; .bin/.flys and evidence result.json: sha256 of raw bytes

conditions.inhibitory_set: S = I1 plus R6's 31 T1 candidates (dense indices from R6 result.json 'candidates'); 32 cells, all with negative R1 sign
conditions.intervention: every stored entry of W[post, pre] whose presynaptic column is in S is multiplied by g (CSR structure preserved; g = 1 bitwise identical to W); all other weights unchanged

stimulated.DNg100_L: dense index resolved from body ID 10045

conditions.order: I2 first; then DNg75_R, DNa02_L, DNg100_L; within each, levels in the listed order
conditions.storage: every run stored; per-MN detail only for runs with score >= 0.5

model: R1's model and R3's replicate function unchanged, applied to a model copy whose W is the scaled matrix
readout: R3's: MN score, frequency, median recruited, E1/E2/I1 trace rhythmicity, activity, mean rates; IGNITED = median recruited >= 500 (R2 RANGE_MAX)

acceptance.validity: at g = 1, DNg75_R and DNa02_L each score >= 0.5; else INVALID
acceptance.removal_per_driver: scan g = 0.75, 0.5, 0.25, 0; loss level = first g whose score is not >= 0.5 (NaN counts as lost); LOST_BY_IGNITION if that condition is IGNITED and median E1 trace rhythmicity < 0.5 (NaN counts as < 0.5); LOST_OTHER otherwise; NOT_LOST if no loss
acceptance.b_holds: DNg100_L score >= 0.5 and not IGNITED at any g in {1.5, 2, 3} (three chances, disclosed)

reported_not_gated: score, frequency and recruitment curves vs g for all three DNs

integrity.I1: source hashes; R1 network body-ID hash; S has 32 distinct cells, all inhibitory in R1's signs; R1b z*/m_VNC reproduced; stimulated DNs in the network
integrity.I2_r6_reproduction: hard gate: via the scaled-W path at g = 1, R6 STIM for DNg75_R and DNa02_L at seeds 3001-3004 (8 simulations) must equal R6's stored runs exactly (score, recruited, core activity)
integrity.I3_tests: tests/test_dng100_balance_test.py passes (scaling touches only S's columns, g = 1 identical; g = 0 matches silencing S for the other cells on a toy network to solver tolerance; removal scan and classes; boost rule; verdict; expectations; I2 check)

expectations.note: recorded in the design before any R7 simulation; wrong ones are recorded as wrong

plumbing_disclosure: Before registration: (1) the toy test showed g = 0 equals silencing S only to ODE solver tolerance (~1e-5 relative; adaptive step control also sees S's own rates), not bitwise, so the test tolerance was set to 1e-4; (2) the first timing attempt failed because 10045 is DNg100_L's body ID, not its dense index; fixed to resolve the dense index from the body ID; (3) one unscaled R1SIZE DNg100_L simulation at seed 0 (not a protocol seed) was then timed (0.74 s); its score and rates were not printed.
execution: one command (--output) runs I2 and all 768 simulations and evaluates in the same process; output opened exclusively; run once.
interpretation_limits: R1's sizes only, at one drive; the rhythm is absent with cord-only sizes at R3's drive.
One inhibitory set (I1 plus 31 short-loop partners) scaled uniformly; other inhibitory cells unchanged.
Eight g levels, 32 seeds; (b) has three chances.
A weight intervention: a probe of model dynamics, not a fidelity correction or biological claim.
Reconstructed rate model; R1's transmitter signs; 68 bodymap MNs.
Neural only: no body or physics; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
